title: Answer packs, candidate-bug escalation and mid-event correction/rescore protocol are absent

original_titles.title: Answer-pack data model entirely missing (gt.answer_packs, gt.answer_pack_entries, gt.answer_pack_links; one_active_pack index; two-approver activation; pack immutability triggers)
gt.candidate_bugs and the unplanned-bug queue (/challenges/:id/candidate-bugs) missing

Mid-event correction protocol (patch E.3) not implemented: no impact-preview dry run, no two-approver approval, no announcement preview/leak guard, no timing guard, no activation, no rescore job (JOB-09), no correction ID
unplanned_valid decision regenerates review items in a loop with no terminal state
No post-freeze ground-truth correction path with impact preview (GT-05a S1, RS-01a)
Unplanned-finding promotion and rescoring runs do not exist
Unplanned-bug promotion has no endpoint and no deterministic rescore

problem: The GT schema has bugs, flags, revisions, aliases, locations and test cases but no answer_packs, candidate_bugs or correction entity. A reviewer can choose unplanned_valid, but it merely changes status to needs_review and enqueues create_review_item again. There is no candidate decision queue, impact preview, two-person correction activation or deterministic rescore job.
impact: A valid but unkeyed defect cannot be safely promoted and scored mid-event. Corrections require manual SQL or manual score adjustments, with no reproducible affected-team preview or reversal chain.

evidence_paths: backend/app/evaluator.py: create_review_item and score ledger paths
backend/app/routers/admin.py: ground truth and manual adjustment routes
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Add gt.candidate_bugs with links to submission, flag/report locations, reviewer rationale, status, rejection reason, origin and audit timestamps. A reviewer decision should create one pending candidate, not re-enqueue itself indefinitely.
Add immutable versioned answer packs with entries keyed by award_unit_id, source/origin and challenge version; enforce one active pack per event/challenge with a partial unique index.
Build a correction draft workflow: proposed change, reason, affected submissions/teams, score deltas, leaderboard preview and announcement preview. The preview must be read-only.
Require two distinct approvers plus step-up to activate a correction. Apply timing guard near the stage end with an explicit emergency override.

Enqueue an idempotent rescore job under a correction_id. Append ledger reversals and replacement awards; never update/delete historical ledger rows. Publish a new leaderboard snapshot and audit every phase.

acceptance_criteria: An unplanned_valid decision creates one candidate row and reaches a terminal state.
A correction preview has no side effects and returns deterministic affected-team/delta data.
Two different approvers are required to activate.
Rescore is idempotent and ledger history is append-only, with reversal links.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
